author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Karnataka's Planning and Statistics Minister, D. Sudhakar, a senior Congress leader and MLA from Hiriyur, passed away early Sunday at 66 after a prolonged lung infection.  His demise, confirmed by the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences, has deeply saddened Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar, who lauded Sudhakar's exemplary public service as a cabinet colleague and legislator.
title: Karnataka minister D Sudhakar passes away at 66 following prolonged illness

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Virat Kohli is on the cusp of another IPL record, needing just 28 runs against Mumbai Indians to become the first batter to score 1,000 IPL runs against them. This achievement would mark the fifth team he has surpassed this milestone against in his illustrious IPL career.
title: Virat Kohli poised for history against MI, set to become first batter to...

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: App developer Rave has sued Apple in a US federal court. Rave alleges Apple removed its app from the App Store to reduce competition. This action allegedly harmed consumers by limiting cross-platform viewing. Rave seeks reinstatement and significant damages. Apple denies the claims, citing guideline violations. This case adds to Apple's ongoing App Store legal challenges.
title: Canadian developer takes Apple to court for removing its app from App Store

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: C Joseph Vijay was sworn in as Tamil Nadu Chief Minister after his party, TVK, emerged as the single largest in the assembly. Vijay secured the required majority with support from Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi and Indian Union Muslim League, unseating traditional Dravidian parties. He will seek a vote of confidence by May 13.
title: TVK ends DMK-AIADMK era, actor-politician Vijay sworn in as Tamil Nadu chief minister

author: TNN
description: In a notable move, the Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has welcomed the expertise of retired IAS officer Subrata Gupta as an adviser, shortly after Gupta wrapped up his role as a special observer for the recent assembly elections. Additionally, Shantanu Bala has been entrusted with the position of CM's private secretary.
title: West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari picks ex-EC observer as his adviser

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Nvidia's chief Jensen Huang sees a future where computers understand the physical world. This 'Physical AI' will revolutionize industries like manufacturing and logistics. Every object will have a precise 3D digital twin. This allows for virtual testing of robots and simulations. Generative AI will then interact with these digital twins, merging creativity with the real world.
title: Nvidia Jensen Huang on what excites him to most when it comes to robotics and physical AI

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Hardik Pandya has excelled for India in crunch T20 situations since 2024 but struggled to replicate that impact for Mumbai Indians. His bowling economy and batting strike rate dip sharply for MI, especially in death overs. Questions resurfaced after MI’s record 103-run loss to CSK, where Hardik avoided bowling late despite having overs left, highlighting his contrasting performances for franchise and country.
title: Hardik Pandya: India's ‘Clutch God’ who disappears for Mumbai Indians

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Iran's IRGC has warned of a "heavy assault" on US military assets and ships if Iranian oil tankers or commercial vessels are attacked in the Strait of Hormuz. This follows US forces disabling two Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman and an earlier exchange of fire near the strait.
title: ‘Missiles, drones locked on US targets’: Iran warns of ‘heavy assault’ after tanker strikes in Gulf of Oman

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Gujarat Titans crushed Rajasthan Royals by 77 runs after posting 229/4, powered by Shubman Gill’s 84 and Sai Sudharsan’s 55. Rashid Khan starred with 4/33 as Rajasthan collapsed for 152 despite a quickfire 36 from teenager Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. Gill later mocked Rajasthan online, posting: “Pink city, blue result. Khamma Ghani.”
title: 'Khamma Ghani': Gill, Rashid tease Rajasthan with witty social media post

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Global oil inventories are rapidly depleting due to the Iran war disrupting crude flows from the Persian Gulf, leading to concerns of price spikes and shortages.  Asia faces immediate pressure, with some nations potentially experiencing shortages within a month as reserves hit multi-year lows.  Strategic reserves are being deployed, but this further weakens the global safety buffer.
title: Strait trouble: Global oil tanks run dry at unprecedented pace as Hormuz remains choked

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Congress is deliberating on its Kerala chief minister choice, with V.D. Satheesan, Ramesh Chennithala, and K.C. Venugopal as top contenders.  Meetings with the high command are ongoing, with a decision expected imminently.  The party is also addressing internal indiscipline following public demonstrations supporting individual leaders.
title: Congress hunts for consensus as camps flex muscle in CM battle: What’s happening Kerala

author: MAHIMA ROY
description: Megan Thee Stallion, the three time Grammy winner, and the Dallas Mavericks’ star player, Klay Thompson’s high profile break up has sparked shockwaves across the world as many are furious. As fans rooted for their future together, Megan Thee Stallion has now broken her silence on her life.
title: Megan Thee Stallion opens up on independence amid Klay Thompson drama

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Central Mali is reeling from a brutal wave of jihadist attacks, with at least 70 lives lost in recent days. The Al-Qaeda-linked JNIM has claimed responsibility for the coordinated assaults, which targeted villages that resisted their control. This escalating violence follows earlier deadly incidents and a prison raid, highlighting the persistent threat in the region.
title: Over 70 killed in attacks in Mali; Al-Qaeda linked JNIM claims responsibility

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Passengers from the hantavirus-affected MV Hondius will disembark in Tenerife on Sunday. Three passengers have died, and five others tested positive after leaving the ship. The Andes virus strain, which can spread person-to-person, was detected. Spanish authorities confirmed the deceased and their belongings will not be unloaded.
title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship to arrive in Tenerife today; WHO head chief reaches Spanish island

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Rajasthan Royals have equalled an IPL record by conceding seven totals of over 200 runs in a single season. This worrying bowling trend follows a strong start to IPL 2026. Gujarat Titans posted 229/4 against them in Jaipur. Shubman Gill and Sai Sudharsan starred for GT. This puts immense pressure on Rajasthan's batting.
title: Rajasthan Royals equal all-time unwanted IPL record vs Gujarat Titans

author: TAMAGHNA BANERJEE, SUDIPTO DAS, DIPAWALI MITRA
description: In his inaugural address, Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari called on his supporters at Jorasanko Thakurbari to move away from partisan slogans like 'Jai Shri Ram,' stating that his leadership embodies the spirit of every citizen in Bengal. He emphasized the urgent need to repair and rejuvenate the state's educational and cultural landscape, drawing inspiration from Rabindranath Tagore’s vision.
title: I'm CM for all, says Suvendu Adhikari, shuts up 'Jai Shri Ram' chant

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Gujarat Titans surged to second place with a dominant 77-run victory over Rajasthan Royals, significantly boosting their playoff chances to 72.52%. Shubman Gill and Sai Sudharsan starred with the bat, while Rashid Khan impressed with the ball. Despite the loss, Rajasthan Royals maintain a higher overall playoff probability due to their easier remaining schedule.
title: IPL Playoff Probabilities: GT’s win lifts odds to 72.52%; RR still at 80.31%

author: MALATHY IYER
description: In a wave of legal challenges tied to the Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) Act, doctors are under heightened scrutiny. Even with an expanded window for obtaining abortions, critics argue that the legislation still favors medical authority over women's rights to choose. Advocates are pushing for the complete decriminalization of abortion and full autonomy for women in making these decisions.
title: Lawyers, doctors feel MTP law puts medical assent over women’s autonomy, seek change

author: ATUL THAKUR
description: Crime rates in Indian cities are set to show a decline in 2027 due to a mathematical glitch in National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) calculations. NCRB uses outdated Census population figures as denominators, causing crime rates to appear inflated until the next Census updates these numbers, leading to dramatic drops.
title: Census effect: Cities will see ‘less crime’ next year

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A trespasser was killed after being struck by a Frontier Airlines flight during takeoff at Denver International Airport. The individual had breached security by jumping the perimeter fence and running onto the runway. Seventeen people were injured in the incident, with the pilot stopping takeoff procedures immediately.
title: Trespasser killed after being hit by plane during takeoff at Denver airport; 17 injured

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Shubman Gill, leading Gujarat Titans to a commanding win, expressed satisfaction with their dominant performance while still seeking a 'perfect match'.  Despite a strong batting display and a comfortable victory, Gill highlighted areas for improvement, emphasizing aggressive bowling and crucial partnerships. He also confirmed a minor ankle scare during the innings, as the team continues its winning streak.
title: 'Still haven’t played a perfect match'- Shubman Gill’s warning to other teams

author: SACHIN SHARMA
description: A 30-year-old man, Samir Panchal, tragically died when his car caught fire on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway near Vadodara. He was en route to Bilimora to surprise his pregnant wife and bring her home. The vehicle reportedly first collided with a crash barrier before erupting in flames.
title: Gujarat shocker: 30-year-old’s ‘surprise’ visit to pregnant wife ends in road tragedy

author: GEORGE MENDONCA
description: NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule's car was grazed by an SUV on the Mumbai-Pune Expressway near the Madap tunnel due to reckless driving. While Sule and her companions escaped unhurt, the Khalapur police have registered an FIR against the SUV driver for rash and negligent driving.
title: SUV grazes MP Supriya Sule's car on Mumbai-Pune Expressway, all escape unhurt

author: PRASAD JOSHI
description: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi alleged the Nashik TCS exploitation case is an intentional attempt to target educated Muslim youths, claiming it lacks legal standing and faces a media trial. He stated the corporator involved will contest the matter legally, asserting the party's unawareness of the incident and that recovered items are not illegal.
title: TCS Nashik case: 'Planned bid to trouble educated Muslim youths,' says Owaisi
